ruleWarningPlan.status: overview and section rules researched; publication-time currentness checks required
rulesToNormalize: The trail crosses Padjelanta/Badjelánnda National Park and parts of the wider Laponia World Heritage Site; allemansrätten is limited by protected-area regulations.
Dogs are prohibited in the Laponia national parks except leashed dogs from 1 January to 30 April. Summer hiking with dogs through Padjelanta/Badjelánnda is therefore not allowed.
Drone flights in Padjelanta/Badjelánnda, Sarek, and Stora Sjöfället/Stuor Muorkke national parks require permission.
Visitors must not intentionally disturb reindeer or reindeer herding. Avoid camping or resting close to private cabins, goahti/kåtor, paths, or reindeer enclosures.
Cycling is prohibited inside the Laponia national parks/nature reserves except listed roads outside the hiking route context.
No trash handling in the mountains: pack out all waste.
currentnessRefreshRequired: Laponia summer bridge deployment/removal and bridge damage.
Pärlälven/Försvarsmakten restrictions near the southern approach.
